extensionDescription.message: AI-powered instant speech translation for all video meetings. Break language barriers with real-time voice translation.

clickToStart.message: Click "Open MAO Chat" below to start real-time translation.

quickStartInstructions.message: Configure your API key (OpenAI or Gemini) → Select "MAO Chat Virtual Microphone" as microphone → Start speaking!

gatherTownGuidance.message: Kutumia MAO Chat, chagua "MAO Chat Virtual Microphone" katika mipangilio ya kipaza sauti chako.

wherebyGuidance.message: Kutumia MAO Chat, tafadhali chagua "MAO Chat Virtual Microphone" katika mipangilio ya kipaza sauti chako na lemaza kupunguza kelele kwa utendaji bora zaidi.

defaultGuidance.message: To use MAO Chat, please select "MAO Chat Virtual Microphone" in your microphone settings.

discordGuidance.message: To use MAO Chat, please select "MAO Chat Virtual Microphone" in your microphone settings and disable Noise Suppression in Discord's Voice settings for better performance.

slackGuidance.message: To use MAO Chat in Slack Huddles, please start a Huddle, then select "MAO Chat Virtual Microphone" in your Video and Mic settings, and disable Noise Suppression in Audio & Video preferences for better performance.

teamsTitle.message: MAO Chat kwa ajili ya Microsoft Teams

teamsGuidance.message:
Ikiwa huoni orodha kamili ya vifaa vya sauti katika mipangilio ya Teams:
1) Zima kwa muda ugani wa MAO Chat na onyesha upya ukurasa
2) Ruhusu Teams kufikia maikrofoni na kamera yako unapoombwa
3) Washa tena ugani wa MAO Chat na onyesha upya ukurasa tena
4) Ruhusu MAO Chat kufikia maikrofoni yako unapoombwa. Sasa unapaswa kuona vifaa halisi na "MAO Chat Virtual Microphone" katika mipangilio yako.

jitsiGuidance.message: Ili kutumia MAO Chat katika Jitsi Meet, fungua Settings > Devices na uchague "MAO Chat Virtual Microphone" kama maikrofoni yako. Kisha fungua Advanced audio settings na uzime Noise suppression, Echo cancellation, na Automatic gain control kwa sauti ya tafsiri iliyo wazi.

desktopCtaBody.message: Maikrofoni wa kawaida wa mfumo mzima kwa OBS, YouTube, Twitch na programu yoyote ya desktop. Windows · macOS · Linux.

browserSitesHeading.message: Unapenda kivinjari? MAO Chat inafanya kazi kwenye tovuti hizi — bofya kufungua:

detectFailBody.message: Onyesha upya ukurasa na ufungue MAO Chat tena.
